subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'gw' na 'mw' pamwe nenzvovera dzose: gwa, gwe, gwi, gwo, gwu; mwa, mwe, mwi, mwo, mwu. Edza kududza ruzha urwu zvakanaka usati waenda mberi.

Mazwi anoumbwa nemitinhimira iyi anosanganisira: Gwara, Gwenzi, Gwizo, Gwande, Gwayi, Gwaya.

Mazwi anokosha okudzidza: vadzidzisi, makore, mapenzura, zvikoro, zvidzidzo (aya mazwi ari muuzhinji).

Ndima inotaura nezvedzidzo semhaka yakakosha - vana vanofanira kuteerera vadzidzisi vavo uye kushanda nesimba pazvidzidzo zvavo kuti vabudirire.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'ts' na 'nzv'.

Nyaya inotaura nezvokurima mubindu: zvinodiwa pakurima zvinosanganisira kudiridza, kusakura, uye kupfuya mhuka. Mbesa dzinorimwa dzinosanganisira madomasi, nyemba nemagaka.

Zvipfuyo zvinotipa nyama nemazai, uye mombe inotipawo mukaka.

Mazwi ane 'ts': utsi, tsito, matsi, tsitsi, tsiga, tsika - aya mazwi anobatsira kudzidza ruzha urwu.

Mazwi anoreva zvakafanana anosanganisira: bindu, zhinji, kupfuya, shasha, zvipfuyo, mambo, vhiki, kukotsira.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'nj', 'ngw' na 'mbw', tichishandisa mazita emifananidzo akadai naNgwena, Mbwanana, Njiva, Shumba naMvuu.

Vana vemhuka: mhuru (mombe), nhiyo (mbudzi kana hwai), mbudzana (mbudzi), gwayana (hwai), mbwanana (imbwa).

Midziyo yapamusha nemabasa ayo: banga - kucheka; ndiro - kudyira chikafu; demo - kutema huni; badza - kusakura; chitofu - kubika; bhara - kutakura zvinhu.

Mhuka dzepamba (dzinochengetwa nevanhu): mbudzi, katsi, hwai, huku. Mhuka dzemusango: shumba, mbada, nyoka, njiri, bere.

Dzimba dziri pamusha nezvadzo: Hozi - munochengeterwa zvirimwa; Gota - imba inorara vakomana; Nhanga - imba inorara vasikana.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'kw' na 'ndw', uye tinodzidza mararamiro akanaka okukwazisana nevanhu vakasiyana-siyana.

Mitauro yokukwazisa inosiyana zvichienderana nenguva yezuva: Mangwanani (kwaedza), Masikati (masikati), Manheru (madekwana).

Mimwe mibvunzo inowanzobvunzwa pakukwazisana: Zita rako ndiani? Unoenda kuchikoro nguvai? Wakazvarwa gore ripi?

Kukwazisana kwakanaka kunoratidza tsika dzakanaka uye kunobatsira kusimbisa hukama pakati pevanhu.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'bh', 'dzv' na 'tsv'.

Tinotaura nezvezvinhu zvinowanikwa pachikoro: zvivakwa, mitambo inoitwa pachikoro, uye zita romudzidzisi mukuru.

Mazwi anotsanangura mavara: tsvuku (red), dema (black), varefu (tall), dzvuku (dark red), jena (white).

Mitambo inoitwa pachikoro inosanganisira bhora remakumbo (football) nemimwe mitambo yakasiyana-siyana.

Ndima inotibatsira kuverenga tichijekesa mavara pamwe nokupindura mibvunzo yenzwisiso.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu mukana wokudzokorora zvadzidzwa muzvikamu 1-5, uchishandisa mitinhimira nh, bv, nd, ch, tsv, uye ngw.

Mazwi okudzokorora anosanganisira: chikepe, duri, badza, mutsvairo, guyo, mugoti, rusero, hwedza.

Zvimiso zvinodzidzwa: Zita rako ndiani? Ini ndine makore masere. Ndiani mutungamiriri weZimbabwe? Zvakakosha kuchengetedza masango. Pamusha pedu pane tsime. Tinofanira kugeza maoko kana tabva kuchimbuzi.

Uku ndikodzidziso yokuti hutano hwakanaka hunosanganisira kugeza maoko nokuchengetedza zvakatipoteredza sezvakaita masango nemvura.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'nh', 'bv' na 'ngw', tichitaura nezvemitambo yakasiyana-siyana yatinofarira nemitemo yayo.

Tinodzidzawo mazwi ehukama: sekuru, tete, amaiguru, ambuya, babamukuru - aya mazita anoratidza ukama hwedu nehama dzedu.

Mazwi eukama kubva patsoro anosanganisira: Mukomana, Ambuya, Tezvara, Sekuru, amai, Tete, Muzukuru.

Kuziva ukama kunobatsira kuremekedza uye kunzwisisa mabatirwo edu nehama.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'dzv' na 'tsw', tichidzidza nezvenyika yedu Zimbabwe.

Ruzivo rwakakosha: Zimbabwe yakawana rusununguko rwayo muna 1980. Guta guru reZimbabwe ndiHarare. Zvinobuda pasi (mineral) zvinosanganisira goridhe, dhayamondi nemarasha. Mamwe maguta makuru anosanganisira Harare, Bulawayo, Mutare, Gweru, neMasvingo, uye mamwe mavara emaguta anosanganisira Bindura, Chinhoyi, Lupane, neGwanda.

Zimbabwe inganana nedzimwe nyika: Mozambique (kumabvazuva), Zambia (kuchamhembe), Botswana (kumavirira), neSouth Africa (kumaodzanyemba). Zimbabwe ine nyika ina dzayakaganhurana nadzo.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'ng', 'ngw' na 'nzv', tichitaura nezvenzvimbo dzokushanyira munyika medu.

Nzvimbo inokosha yokushanyira ndiVictoria Falls, ine makarwe (crocodiles) uye mumvura mizhinji - zvakakosha kuti tichengete makarwe nemvura yacho.

Mazwi anoreva zvakafanana: chikepe (garwe), dutavanhu, bindu, kuchengeta mhuka.

Kushanya kunobatsira kuziva nezvenyika yedu uye kunofadza vashanyi vanobva kunze kwenyika.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'pf' na 'shw', tichitaura nezvemamiriro ekunze akasiyana-siyana sedutu (storm), zhizha (summer), nechando.

Kana kuine dutu, matenga edzimba anogona kutorwa nemhepo. Panguva yezhizha, mvura inonaya uye tinoshandisa masamburera (umbrella) nemumvuri kuzvidzivirira.

Mbatya dzatinofanira kupfeka dzinoenderana nemamiriro ekunze: pachando tinopfeka majuzi kana mabhachi; pamvura tinofuka samburera kana kupfeka renikoti.

Mazwi anopikisana: tsamwa/nyarara, mberi/shure, vhura/vhara, musikana/murume.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu mukana wokudzokorora zvadzidzwa muzvikamu 7-10.

Mazwi anoreva zvakafanana: garwe (twiza, chikwere), shamwari (dede).

Ukama: ambuya, sekuru, tete, babamudiki - dzokororo yamazwi ehukama.

Mazwi anopikisana: madokero (kumabvazuva), suwa (farirwa), nyarara (taura), pisa (tonhora), mukuru/muhombe (diki).

Chikamu ichi chinosimbisa unyanzvi hwokushandisa mazwi anoreva zvakafanana uye anopikisana muzvirevo.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'mw' na 'nzw', tichidzidza nezvemwaka yegore: chirimo, zhizha, uye chando.

Muzhizha, vanhu vanorima mbeswa dzakadai sechibage, nzungu, nedonje. Mbesa idzi dzinochengetwa mudura kana zvaunwa/zvakohwewa (harvested), uye dzimwe dzinotengeswa.

Munhu anonzi hurudza kana ane mukurumbira wokurima zvakanaka.

Mazita edzimba dzinowanikwa pamusha: chirugu, danga (kwakachengetwa mombe), dendere (dzimba dzeshiri), dura (kwakachengetwa zviyo), bikiro (kwokubikira), zumbu.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'pf' na 'chw', tichidzidza nezvezvipfeko zvakasiyana-siyana nokuti pakupfeka izvi panokosha here.

Zvipfeko zvakakodzera pamamiriro ekunze: pachando tinopfeka majuzi kana mabhachi echando; kana kuchinaya tinofuka renikoti kana samburera.

Zvipfeko zvimwe zvinoshandiswa pabasa rakachena, senge magambutsu neherometi zvinodzivirira kubva kune njodzi dzepabasa.

Kupfeka zvakakodzera nemamiriro ekunze kunochengetedza utano hwedu.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'bw' na 'chw', tichidzidza nezvemabasa akasiyana-siyana nounyanzvi hwawo.

Mabasa nounyanzvi hwawo: hurudza (murimi ane mukurumbira), hombarume (muvhimi), mhizha (anogadzira zvinhu zvesimbi), chiremba (anorapa varwere), mupurisa (anochengetedza mutemo), mauto (anochengetedza nyika), bhiridha (anovaka), gweta (anomiririra vanhu mudare).

Nyaudzosingwi (mazwi anoratidza ruzha): tsvete, ngee, zii, ndoo, kwetsu.

Midziyo inoshandiswa pabasa inosanganisira: demo, badza, chirauro, banga.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'zv', 'dzv' na 'tsv', tichidzidza nezvokukosha kwemasango uye nzira dzokuachengetedza.

Mumasango munowanikwa mhuka dzakasiyana-siyana dzomusango dzakadai senzou, shumba, mapere, nyati, nembizi, dzinowanikwa muno muZimbabwe uye kunze kwenyika.

Zvinowanikwa mumasango: musasa, mapango, uye mhuka semagudo nezizi.

Zvinongedzo (pointing words) zvinodzidzwa: idzo, awo, idzi, iri, iyo - izvi zvinobatsira kutsanangura zvinhu zviri pedyo kana kure.

Kuchengetedza masango kunobatsira mhuka nemiti kuti zvirambe zvichiwanikwa kuzvizvarwa zvinotevera.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu mukana wokudzokorora mabasa nounyanzvi (hurudza, mhizha, hombarume, muvezi, bhiridha) uye nyaudzosingwi (zii, kwetsu, ndoo, ngwee, tsvete).

Tinodzokororawo pakugara kwemhuka: mombe/mbudzi dzinogara mudanga; huku dzinogara muzumbu; shumba nembizi dzinogara musango.

Mbatya nemamiriro ekunze zvinodzokororwawo: samburera nerenikoti pamvura; majuzi pachando.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'nzw', tichidzidza mwedzi yegore yose gumi nemiviri (12) uye kuiteverana kwayo.

Mwedzi inosanganisira: Ndira (January) kusvika Zvita (December). Mabasa anoitwa nemwaka: chirimo (kurima/kudyara), zhizha (mvura inonaya), chando (kutonhora).

Mhuka neruzha rwadzo: shumba - inodzvova; imbwa - inohukura; jongwe - rinokukuridza; shiri - inorira; mbudzi - inomemedza; dhongi - rinokuma.

Kuziva mwedzi negore kunobatsira kuronga mabasa nemhemberero munguva dzakakodzera.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'mbw', tichidzidza nzira dzokufambisa mashoko dzepasichigare nedzemazuva ano.

Nzira dzepasichigare dzokufambisa mashoko: ngoma, hwamanda, utsi, uye nhume (munhu anotumwa).

Nzira dzemazuva ano: madzimudzangara (radio), nhare (runhare), nharembozha (foni yerudzi), uye zvivhitivhiti (terevhizhoni).

Kufambiswa kwemashoko kwakachinja zvakanyanya kubva kare kusvika nhasi, zvichiita kuti ruzivo rufambe nokukurumidza.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'bh', tichidzidza nezvemabiko akasiyana-siyana sebhavhadhi (birthday party).

Tinodzidza mazita anopiwa vanhu zvichienderana nokuberekwa kwavo: dangwe (mwana wokutanga), gotwe (mwana wokupedzisira), goremucheche (mwana asingakuri), gavamwedzi (mwana akaberekwa asati asvika nguva yake), mapatya (vana vaviri vakazvarwa panguva imwe), nherera (mwana akafirwa nevabereki vake), jaya (mukomana mukuru), mhandara (musikana mukuru).

Pamabiko, vanhu vanoita zvinoitwa senge kuimba, kudya, uye kupiwa zvipo.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'tw' na 'ngw', tichidzidza nezvenhengo dzomuviri nemabasa adzo.

Tinoona nameso, tinonzwa nenzeve, tinofembera nemhino, uye tinofamba namakumbo.

Mazwi anotsanangura vanhu vane matambudziko: bofu (munhu asingaoni), mbeveve (munhu asingatauri), matsi (munhu asinganzwi).

Uzhinji hwenhengo dzomuviri: masora (nhengo), matede, mikova, mapadza, misoro, misana.

Tinofanira kuchengetedza nhengo dzomuviri wedu dzichigara dzakachena uye dzakasimba.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu mukana wokudzokorora mazita akapihwa vanhu zvichienderana nezviitiko zvavo: dangwe, gotwe, hurudza, gweta, chiremba, bofu, mbeveve, matsi, mapatya, goremucheche, nherera.

Tinodzokororawo ukama: mainini, sekuru, tete, ambuya.

Uye tinodzokorora mazwi anopikisana: murefu/mupfupi.

Zvimiso zvinodzokororwa zvinosanganisira mibvunzo pamusoro penyika yedu neguta guru reZimbabwe.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'mbw', tichidzidza nezvokudya kwepasichigare kwaidyiwa nemadzitateguru edu.

Kudya kunobva mumhando dzakasiyana: zvirimwa nemhuka. Kubva pazviyo tinowana chibage, mhunga, mapfunde, nemupunga. Michero yesango inosanganisira tsambatsi, matohwe, uye maroro.

Zvimwe zvokudya zvinowanikwa munzvimbo dzedu zvinosanganisira madora (mhando dzeshwa/insects) nemukaka unobva kumombe.

Kudya kwepasichigare kwaiva nehutano hukuru uye kwaiwanikwa munzvimbo dzedu pachedu.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'chw', tichidzidza nezvezororo reKisimusi rinoitwa muna Zvita (December).

PaKisimusi, vanhu vanoshanyirana neshamwari nehama, vachifara nezvakawanda.

Mhando dzemazororo dzinosanganisira: Isita, zororo remagamba, zororo rekurangarira kuzvitonga kuzere, uye zororo revashandi.

Pazororo, vanhu vanofarira zvokudya nezvokunwa pamwe nemimhanzi.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'nzw', tichitaura nezvenzendo dzatakamboita nebhazi kuenda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana.

Panzendo, tinowanzoona mhuka, makomo, nemiti. Zvifambiso zvakasiyana-siyana zvinosanganisira: igwa (rinofamba mumvura), dutavanhu/bhazi (rinofamba pasi), bhizautare, uye chitima (rinofamba pasi).

Ndege dzinofamba mudenga, ichi chinova chimwe chikamu chinobatsira kunzwisisa kuti zvifambiso zvinofamba sei - mumvura, pasi, kana mudenga.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'mb' na 'vh', tichidzidza nezvemichina yemakombiyuta uye mabasa ayo.

Makombiyuta anobatsira muzvinhu zvakawanda, kusanganisira kuita mapurojekita nokuwana ruzivo, semuenzaniso ruzivo nezvemvura kana nezvevatungamiriri venyika.

Mazwi anoreva zvakafanana nemichina yokufambisa mashoko: terevhizheni, dzimudzangara, foni, nharembozha.

Kudzidza kushandisa makombiyuta zvakanaka kunokosha munguva dzino dzeteknoroji.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'ty', tichidzidza nezvekodzero dzevana uye kuti vanofanira kuita sei kana kodzero dzavo dzikatyorwa.

Kodzero dzevana dzinosanganisira: zvokupfeka zvakakwana, zvokudya nokunwa, zvokunamata, utano nokurapwa, uye kugara panzvimbo yakachengeteka.

Kana munhu upi zvake - kunyangwe vabereki, vadzidzisi, kana vanhu vaunogara navo - achida kukubunyikidza kodzero dzako kana kukutyisidzira kuti usataure, unofanira KUSATYA kutaura chokwadi. Munhu anogona kukupa zvipo kuti unyarare kana kuti usataure - izvi hazvisi zvakanaka, uye unofanira kuudza munhu waunovimba naye nokukurumidza.

Vanhu vaunogona kuudza pane dambudziko: mapurisa, mudzidzisi, mubereki, kana mufundisi wechechi. Kutaura hazvisi kunyara - zvinokubatsira newe pachako uye zvinodzivirira vamwe.

Mabasa mumhuri: amai nababa vanochengeta mhuri, vana vanoteerera uye vanobatsira mumhuri, uye ambuya nasekuru vanopa mazano akadzama.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu mukana wokudzokorora mazita emifananidzo (bhazi, tsvimbo, garwe/ngwena, imbwa), zvinongedzo (ava, iri, aya, idzo, iyo), uye mazwi anopikisana akadai nemurefu/mupfupi.

Tinodzokororawo panogara mhuka (danga, dendere, chiro, sango, mumvura) uye mazwi muuzhinji akadai nemapango, matanda, zvituro, mitsvairo.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'shw', tichidzidza nezvokubata ishwa uye kuvhima mhuka dzomusango.

Ishwa dzinowanikwa mumigomo yemuchuru, uye dzinobatwa panguva dzakasiyana. Vanhu vanogona kurumwa namajuru pakubata ishwa.

Mhuka nevana vadzo: mhembwe-tsvana, mombe-mhuru, gudo-rushiye, imbwa-mbwanana, datya-buruvuru.

Mazwi anotsanangura zvinodyiwa: Hwahwa - hunodhaka; Mhiripiri - inovava; Mbambaira - dzinozvimbira; Hutsi - hunokachidza; Huchi - hunotapira.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'tsv', tichiteerera nokutaura ngano dzinotaura nezvemhuka dzakadai netsuro, nzou, neshumba.

Ngano dzinowanzotaurwa panguva yeRuvhunzavaeni (zuva rodoka), vanhu vachigara padare (nzvimbo yokugarira nekutaurirana).

Munongano, tsuro inowanzoratidzwa senjere pane mamwe mhuka - semuenzaniso, tsuro nambira mungano dzakasiyana-siyana.

Kuteerera nokudzokorora ngano kunobatsira kusimudzira unyanzvi hwokutaura nokuverenga.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'dh', tichidzidza nezvenzvimbo dzinowanikwa mvura uye njodzi dzinogona kuwanikwa mumvura.

Nzvimbo dzinowanikwa mvura dzinosanganisira: tsime, tepi, dhamu, uye chibhorani.

Njodzi dzomumvura dzinosanganisira: kuyeredzwa nemvura inoyerera, kubatwa nemudumbu/manyoka (semuenzaniso bilharzia), kunyura, uye kutsva.

Mhuka dzinowanikwa mumvura dzinosanganisira ngwena (garwe), datya, mvuu, negakanje - dzinofanira kuchenjererwa.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'rw' na 'dzw', tichidzidza nezvokutiva (kuredza hove) uye mabasa emvura akasiyana-siyana.

Panguva yechirimo, vanhu vanotiva, kudiridza mapindu, kana kuraura/kuredza hove vachishandisa zviredzo kana zviraudo nemambure.

Njodzi dzinogona kuwanikwa patinotiva dzinosanganisira kusangana nezvikara zvomumvura sengwena (garwe) kana kunyura mumvura.

Kutiva kunobatsira kuwana zvokudya uye kunofadzawo sechiitiko chomutambo.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Muchikamu chino tinodzidza mitinhimira 'pf' na 'nzw', tichidzidza nezvezororo remagamba rinoitwa muna Nyamavhuvhu (August).

Zororo iri rinorangarira vanhu vakafira nyika vachirwira rusununguko rweZimbabwe kubva pasi pehutongi hwevachena/varungu (colonial rule).

Mamwe mazororo enyika: Zvita (Kisimusi), Ndira (gore idzva), Bandwe (zuva rokuzvitonga kuzere - Independence Day), Nyamavhuvhu (zuva remagamba - Heroes' Day), uye Zvita (zuva rekubatana - Unity Day).

Oliver Mtukudzi ndomumwe wemhinduro pamusoro pemumhanzi anozivikanwa muZimbabwe.

Ruzivo rwenguva: gore rine mwedzi gumi nemiviri (12); vhiki rine mazuva manomwe (7), kusanganisira Mugovera neSvondo.

subject: Shona Grade 2
content:
Uyu ndiwo mukana wokupedzisira wokudzokorora zvose zvadzidzwa mubhuku rino.

Tinodzokorora mazita ezviri pamifananidzo (imbwa, musoja, chitoro, kombiyuta), midziyo namabasa ayo (chirauro, jeko, mbezo, mutswi), uye mazwi muuzhinji (mizhanje, dzimba, madzibaba, makore, zvipatara, maruva, mbudzi).

Tinodzokororawo mazwi anoreva zvakafanana (igwa, dutavanhu, bhizautare) uye tsika nemagariro dzedu, dzakadai nokuombera nokupfugama patinokwazisa vakuru - tsika dzinoratidza rukudzo.

Nokupedza chikamu ichi, mwana anenge apedza kudzidza bhuku rose reGwaro reChipiri muChiShona.
source: PlusOne Rodza Pfungwa ChiShona - Gwaro reChipiri
